info.title: HalloApp Send API
info.description:
REST API for partner applications to send WhatsApp messages through a HalloApp desk: documents, reports, notifications.

## Concepts

- **Desk** – the HalloApp workspace connected to your organization. It is the identity of the caller: every API credential and every message is scoped to one desk.
- **Provider** – each desk sends WhatsApp through one provider, and the rules differ:
  - **InforU desk** – messages MUST go out as a pre-approved template (`templateId` is mandatory).
  - **Green API desk** – free text only (templates are rejected).

  Use the *Templates* endpoint to learn which mode your desk uses (`isInforu` true/false).
- **Files** – always delivered as a **download link**, never as a native WhatsApp attachment. On a Green API desk the `fileUrl` is appended to the message text; on an InforU desk the URL travels as one of the template parameters. The URL must be reachable by the end customer.
- **Chat** – every sent message is stored as a normal HalloApp conversation. If no chat exists for the target phone it is created (along with a phonebook contact). Customer replies land in the same chat and are handled by the desk's agents in the HalloApp UI.

## Authentication

OAuth-style client credentials. You receive a `client_id` (your desk GUID) and a `client_secret` from HalloApp out-of-band. Exchange them at the *Token* endpoint for a bearer token valid for **4 minutes and reusable until it expires**. Send it on every other endpoint as `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.

## Error catalog

Business errors return HTTP 200 with `ok:false` and a `msg` explaining the fix:

| `msg` contains | Cause / fix |
|---|---|
| `client_id and client_secret are required` | missing credentials on `/token` |
| `desk not found for token` | token valid but desk removed/archived |
| `phone is required` / `invalid phone` | missing/empty phone |
| `this desk requires a templateId` | InforU desk – send with `templateId` + `templateParams` |
| `this desk does not support templates` | Green API desk – send free text |
| `template not found for this desk` | wrong `templateId` (use Templates discovery) |
| `template expects N parameter(s), got M` | `templateParams` count must equal `parameterCount` |
| `files are delivered as a link inside a template parameter` | on InforU, include `fileUrl` as one of `templateParams` |
| `agent not found in this desk` | `agentId` is not an active member of the desk |

Authentication failures return **HTTP 401**.

post.description: Exchange your desk credentials for a short-lived bearer token (valid 4 minutes, reusable until expiry).

get.description: Returns the desk's approved WhatsApp templates. `isInforu: false` (empty list) means the desk sends free text – skip templates entirely. `id` is the value to pass as `templateId` on send; `parameterCount` is the exact number of `templateParams` values the template expects.

messageText.example: שלום [#1#], קיבלת [#2#] מספר [#3#] מאת [#4#]. קישור להורדת המסמך: [#5#] . תודה.

get.description: Optional discovery: returns the desk's active agents. Only needed if you want messages attributed to a specific agent via `agentId` on send.

post.description:
Sends a WhatsApp message to the given phone through the token's desk.

**Provider rules**

| Desk provider | `message` | `templateId` + `templateParams` | `fileUrl` |
|---|---|---|---|
| InforU | ignored (template defines the text) | **required**; param count must match `parameterCount` | put the URL **inside** `templateParams` |
| Green API | required (or `fileUrl`) | rejected | appended to the text as a link |

name.description: Used when a new chat/contact is created

agentId.description: Attribute the message to this desk agent; omitted = system message

message.description: Green API desks: the message text

templateParams.description: One value per [#n#] placeholder, in order

200.description: Send result (also used for business errors with ok:false + msg)

msg.description: Present when ok:false - see the error catalog

bearerAuth.description: Obtain via POST /api/halloapp/token (valid 4 minutes, reusable until expiry).
